User Defined Struct member tooltips

ForgeMCP exposes a reviewed, exact-path edit for member tooltip descriptions on an existing Unreal UUserDefinedStruct:

  1. unreal_preview_struct_tooltips accepts an exact /Game/... package path and a map of exact member names to nonempty descriptions (up to 256 entries and 1,024 characters per description).
  2. Preview reports each old and proposed tooltip, fingerprints the full current member schema and tooltip state, and expires after five minutes. It does not mutate or save the asset.
  3. unreal_apply_struct_tooltips requires the matching preview ID as its confirmation. It rejects stale or already-dirty packages, applies each description by the member's stable variable GUID, and saves the existing struct package once. Save failure restores the original package bytes.

The operation does not rename members, change field types, compile unrelated Blueprints, or edit a DataTable. Tooltip text is explanatory metadata; callers must provide accurate units and meanings from the source schema.
